macroExecution.name: Permissions · Run macros
macroExecution.hint: Whether the AI may run macros. Off by default. A chat macro only writes to the chat. A script macro can do anything a Gamemaster can, including deleting and changing settings, and cannot be undone. The switch Allow Write Operations applies as well.
macroExecution.off: Off: the AI runs no macro
macroExecution.all: Chat and script macros (a script can do anything)

notify.chatMacroRun: The AI is running the chat macro {name}.
notify.scriptMacroRun: The AI is running the script macro {name}.
